title: applyLayoutChanges
description: Applies width, height, stroke weight, and corner radius changes from a UI message to every node in the current Figma selection.

params.name: msg
params.description: Layout payload: width, height, radius, radiusIndividual {tl,tr,br,bl}, strokeWeight, constrainProportions, isMainRadiusChanged. Values may be numbers or 'mixed'.

returns.description: No return value; mutates selected nodes in place.
